sections.title: Getting Started
content: Welcome to GrantScout Pro. This guide will help you understand the core features of the platform.
Use the dashboard to navigate between grants, workspaces, applications, and intelligence tools.

sections.title: Workspaces
content: Workspaces allow you to organize grants, team members, and documents.
Each workspace has its own permissions, AI usage, and grant history.

sections.title: Grant Intelligence
content: GrantScout Pro analyzes grants using AI to provide eligibility, competitiveness, risk, and readiness scores.
You can view detailed intelligence inside each grant’s page.

sections.title: Applications
content: Create and manage grant applications directly inside the platform.
Track versions, narratives, budgets, and submission history.

sections.title: AI Tools
content: AI tools help you summarize grants, generate narratives, analyze eligibility, and optimize your application.
AI usage is tracked per workspace.

sections.title: Support
content: If you need help, contact support through your workspace or visit the Help Center.
Enterprise clients receive priority support and onboarding assistance.
